units.source_text: 元旦早晨，源氏公子入朝贺年，先到紫姬房里看看，笑着对她说：

en.t: On New Year's morning, Prince Genji went to court to offer his New Year greetings, but first he stopped by Lady Murasaki's rooms, looked in on her, and said with a smile:
"From today on, you are grown up now, aren't you?"

units.source_text: 他的态度非常和蔼可亲。

en.t: His manner was very gentle and affectionate.

units.source_text: 紫姬元旦一早就起来弄玩偶，非常忙碌。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had risen early on New Year's morning to arrange her dolls, and was very busy.

units.source_text: 她在一对三尺高的橱子里，陈设种种物品，

en.t: Inside a pair of cabinets about three feet high, she had set out all sorts of things,

units.source_text: 又搭了许多小屋子，房间里处处都是玩具，途几为塞。

en.t: and she had built many little houses as well, so that toys were everywhere in the room and the pathways were almost blocked.

units.source_text: 她一本正经地对公子说：

en.t: With a perfectly serious face, she said to the prince:

units.source_text: “昨夜犬君说要打鬼[\[7\]](#part1336.html#m7)，把这个弄坏了，我正在修理呢。”

en.t: "Last night Inuki said she was going to drive out demons[\[7\]](#part1336.html#m7), and she broke this, so I am fixing it now."
She spoke as though she were reporting a matter of great importance.

units.source_text: “哎呀，这个人太不小心了，赶快修理吧。

en.t: "Oh dear, how careless she was. Hurry and mend it.

units.source_text: 今天是元旦，你说话要当心，不可以讲不吉利的话，不要哭。”

en.t: Today is New Year's Day, so you must be careful what you say. Do not say anything unlucky, and do not cry."
After saying this, he went out.

units.source_text: 他今天服装非常华丽，侍女们都走出廊下来送行，紫姬也出来送。

en.t: His clothes that day were extremely splendid, and all the ladies-in-waiting came out to the veranda to see him off; Lady Murasaki came out too.

units.source_text: 回进屋里，她立刻替玩偶中的源氏公子穿上华丽的衣服，模仿入朝贺年的样子。

en.t: When she returned inside, she immediately dressed the Genji doll in splendid clothes, imitating the way he had gone to court for the New Year greetings.
